_meta.purpose: Replacement gilt — selection to first service
_meta.source: PIC Gilt Developer Guide 2023 + Topigs Norsvin Management Guide 2022 + NRC Nutrient Requirements of Swine 2012
_meta.notes: Applies to commercial crossbred gilts (e.g. F1 LW×LD dam, terminal sire). Targets vary ±10% by genetic line.

early.notes: Ad libitum feeding; high-energy grower diet

pre_breed.notes: Limit-feed to 85–90% ad lib; build frame, not fat

service_targets.notes: Flushing (increase feed 0.5–1 kg/d for 10–14 days pre-breed) improves ovulation rate

first_parity_targets.notes: First parity litter size naturally 5–8% smaller than parity 2–5 peak

growth_checkpoints.note: Selection pool entry — cull structurally unsound
First service — 2nd or 3rd heat (P2 backfat 16–20 mm)
